name: Buffalo public evidence
description: A human-executable source packet for tracing Buffalo and Erie County public decisions from notice and agenda to minutes, recordings, records, and supporting data.

sourceMetadata.reviewMethod: Manual check of each official landing page and source purpose.
sourceMetadata.reviewScope: URL reachability and publisher identity, not an audit of every meeting or record.
sourceMetadata.sourcePolicy: Prefer first-party meeting, records, open-data, and public-law sources. Preserve the source's date, status, and limitations.

updateMetadata.beforeUse: Recheck the current meeting page, record status, or FOIL instructions before publishing or relying on them.
updateMetadata.procedure: Update sources.json and this manifest's reviewedAt, then test the claim-to-source ledger on one recent item.

limits: No monitoring, alerts, scraping, transcription, or integrations are included.
The pack does not establish motive, wrongdoing, causation, or legal liability.
Minutes and open-data records may be incomplete, delayed, corrected, or redacted.
The pack is not legal, investigative, or journalistic advice.
